title: The Python solvers of exudyn.symbolics build a scipy sparse matrix in every residual, also for small systems
author: Claude-JG
description: Profiled in #3497: SolveImplicitRungeKutta on a pendulum of 2 coordinates, 400 steps, 1.8 s, of which 1.1 s in creating scipy.sparse.csr_matrix (19116 of them; the mass matrix requested as sparse in the residuals of the finite-difference Jacobian, systemModel.py). The symbolic test models that take 6-18 s spend most of their time there. A dense path below a size, or the mass matrix kept between evaluations when it is constant, would speed up the solvers of exudyn.symbolics for the small systems they are mostly used with.
